text: cool put the value control into the game compile settings so i can control it
resolution: Exposed the palm grove on /settings so the user controls it at compile time (committed). Registered PALM_CONFIG with editorTunables (the same P2 settings door grass/bush use): sliders for the three per-tile spawn chances (density.sparse/med/dense, 0-1), trunk height + radius range, and crown frond count + length — 11 entries under a 'palm' system group. No new plumbing needed: bakeGameFile already folds /settings overrides over the registered defaults (applyOverrides), and the population reads the live PALM_CONFIG, so a compile picks up the tuned values. Verified end-to-end: applying palm.density.med=0.5 changed the live config 0.22→0.5 and a 40×40 field 353→799 palms; 11 palm entries register alongside grass's 11; bake green.
